claims: C1 when requesting confirmation for a potentially sensitive or irreversible action, the assistant should clearly outline what information will be sent
C2 the assistant should clearly outline who will receive the information
C3 the assistant should clearly outline whether the recipient appears trustworthy or the request seems unusual
C4 this context helps the user provide informed consent

concepts.name: potentially_sensitive_or_irreversible_action
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is potentially sensitive or irreversible, so that requesting confirmation before it is appropriate
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'a potentially sensitive or irreversible action' as the occasion for the preference; the class must exist for the condition to range over

concepts.name: confirmation_requested_for
concepts.gloss: C is a confirmation request made for action A
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'requesting confirmation for' an action, so a relation between a confirmation request and the action it concerns must exist

concepts.name: outline_information_sent
concepts.gloss: confirmation request C outlines what information will be sent
concepts.inference: the clause's first listed element of the outline is 'what information will be sent'

concepts.name: outline_recipient
concepts.gloss: confirmation request C outlines who will receive the information
concepts.inference: the clause's second listed element of the outline is 'who will receive it'

concepts.name: outline_trustworthiness_or_unusualness
concepts.gloss: confirmation request C outlines whether the recipient appears trustworthy or the request seems unusual
concepts.inference: the clause's third listed element of the outline is 'whether the recipient appears trustworthy or the request seems unusual'

concepts.name: confirmation_request
concepts.gloss: C is a confirmation request that the assistant makes
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'requesting confirmation', so the act of making a confirmation request must exist

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: ask_clarifying_questions_section_guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #ask_clarifying_questions section and carries guideline authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the section's authority

asserts.read_back: when confirmation is requested for a potentially sensitive or irreversible action, outlining what information will be sent, who will receive it, and whether the recipient appears trustworthy or the request seems unusual is preferred, because this context helps the user provide informed consent

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for outlining confirmation context; it does not forbid or require any act, so silence leaves other responses permitted
